description: Details climate risks and vulnerable population impacts.
Includes guide for equitable climate transition.
Developed with diverse community organizations.

chips.text: Received as information
Developed with input from hundreds of stakeholders and community groups.
Climate impacts will disproportionately affect already under-served populations.
Identifies risks from wildfires, increased heat, and flood events.

speakers.name: Caroline Dinter
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Climate Action Strategy
said: Asked how wildfires and climate change impacts connect to vulnerable populations.
Highlighted the difference between a 25-year plan and immediate responses to events like displacement.
Advocated for better connections and collaboration across city departments.
